ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs in a soft, fluffy mound covering roughly 30% of the plate's upper-right area, pale yellow with orange-tinged streaks and small curds, moist-looking with slight sheen, about 2 cm tall, sitting beside the fruit and sweet potato | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed orange-fleshed roasted sweet potato pieces, roughly 2 to 3 cm chunks with browned, slightly caramelized edges and a matte, somewhat dry surface, clustered in a loose pile on the lower-left of the plate, about 2 cm tall | 95
ITEM 3 | Darker, glossy caramelized sweet potato chunks with brown-purple tinged skin and a sticky, slightly syrupy sheen, about 2 to 3 cm pieces, interspersed among the orange cubes on the left side of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Whole raspberries, bright red, glossy and slightly soft, with visible drupelet bumps, about 1.5 cm each, three to four berries grouped at the right-center edge beside the blackberries | 40
ITEM 5 | Blackberries, dark purple-black, glossy with rounded drupelet clusters, about 2 cm each, four to five berries scattered along the lower-right edge of the plate | 55
